title: Pausable ability prompts
description: Every optional ability that the engine asks a player about on a frequent event (another player's activation, a combat round, a production, a unit loss, a turn start, ...) can now be switched off for this browser, like I48S and Aetherpassage: a checkbox in the offer, an automatic decline with a toast, a Prompts list on the player sheet, and a chip while anything is skipped. 64 abilities are registered (docs/ABILITY_PAUSE_TOGGLES.md has the audit). Mocked game; regenerate with npm run screenshots -- FV.

notes.title: Persistence
notes.text: Each setting is stored in this browser only (localStorage key player_ask_<id>, e.g. player_ask_i48s and player_ask_aetherpassage as before). It applies to all games and survives reloads until switched back on. Storage failures mean ask.

notes.title: When it acts
notes.text: Only the offered seat's own client, only when the game moved forward to the offer (history cursor grew, nothing to redo), and only when every non-decline answer of the question is a paused ability. Page load, reconnect, undo, redo and restore never decline.

notes.title: Not changed
notes.text: No engine, rules, checksum or decision-hash change. The question is still asked and the answer is a recorded submit_choice (the decline). Action cards keep their existing per-game 'Never offer' mode.

notes.title: Audit
notes.text: docs/ABILITY_PAUSE_TOGGLES.md lists every optional ability that was checked, which are registered, which are covered by the action card modes, and which were left out and why.
